import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for the source CSV files
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_74/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_74/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_74/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0
    # Schema: ['ocd_prop_id', 'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'prop_name', 'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'committee_position']
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype={
        'ocd_prop_id': str,
        'calaccess_prop_id': 'Int64',
        'ccdc_prop_id': 'Int64',
        'prop_name': str,
        'ccdc_committee_id': 'Int64',
        'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
        'committee_name': str,
        'committee_position': str
    })

    # Load Source 1
    # Schema: ['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'calaccess_filing_id', 'date_received', 'contributor_lastname', 'contributor_firstname', 'contributor_city', 'contributor_state', 'contributor_zip', 'contributor_employer', 'contributor_occupation', 'contributor_is_self_employed', 'amount']
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={
        'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
        'committee_name': str,
        'calaccess_filing_id': 'Int64',
        'date_received': str,
        'contributor_lastname': str,
        'contributor_firstname': str,
        'contributor_city': str,
        'contributor_state': str,
        'contributor_zip': str,
        'contributor_employer': str,
        'contributor_occupation': str,
        'contributor_is_self_employed': bool,
        'amount': float
    })

    # Rename committee_name in df0 to committee_name_x to distinguish after join
    df0 = df0.rename(columns={'committee_name': 'committee_name_x'})

    # Rename committee_name in df1 to committee_name_y to distinguish after join
    df1 = df1.rename(columns={'committee_name': 'committee_name_y'})

    # Join df0 and df1 on calaccess_committee_id
    # This join is the key to combine proposition info with contributor info
    # Use inner join to keep only matching committees
    df_merged = pd.merge(
        df0,
        df1,
        how='inner',
        on='calaccess_committee_id',
        suffixes=('_x', '_y')
    )

    # Select and reorder columns to match target schema:
    # ['ocd_prop_id': string,
    #  'calaccess_prop_id': integer,
    #  'ccdc_prop_id': integer,
    #  'prop_name': string,
    #  'ccdc_committee_id': integer,
    #  'calaccess_committee_id': integer,
    #  'committee_name_x': string,
    #  'committee_position': string,
    #  'committee_name_y': string,
    #  'calaccess_filing_id': integer,
    #  'date_received': string,
    #  'contributor_lastname': string,
    #  'contributor_firstname': string,
    #  'contributor_city': string,
    #  'contributor_state': string,
    #  'contributor_zip': string,
    #  'contributor_employer': string,
    #  'contributor_occupation': string,
    #  'contributor_is_self_employed': boolean,
    #  'amount': float]

    # Some columns may have missing values, ensure all columns exist
    target_columns = [
        'ocd_prop_id',
        'calaccess_prop_id',
        'ccdc_prop_id',
        'prop_name',
        'ccdc_committee_id',
        'calaccess_committee_id',
        'committee_name_x',
        'committee_position',
        'committee_name_y',
        'calaccess_filing_id',
        'date_received',
        'contributor_lastname',
        'contributor_firstname',
        'contributor_city',
        'contributor_state',
        'contributor_zip',
        'contributor_employer',
        'contributor_occupation',
        'contributor_is_self_employed',
        'amount'
    ]

    # Check if all target columns are in df_merged, if not add with NaN or appropriate default
    for col in target_columns:
        if col not in df_merged.columns:
            # For boolean column, default False; for numeric columns, NaN; for strings, empty string
            if col == 'contributor_is_self_employed':
                df_merged[col] = False
            elif col in ['calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id', 'calaccess_filing_id']:
                df_merged[col] = pd.NA
            elif col == 'amount':
                df_merged[col] = pd.NA
            else:
                df_merged[col] = ""

    # Select and reorder columns
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

    # Ensure correct dtypes for target schema
    df_target = df_target.astype({
        'ocd_prop_id': str,
        'calaccess_prop_id': 'Int64',
        'ccdc_prop_id': 'Int64',
        'prop_name': str,
        'ccdc_committee_id': 'Int64',
        'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
        'committee_name_x': str,
        'committee_position': str,
        'committee_name_y': str,
        'calaccess_filing_id': 'Int64',
        'date_received': str,
        'contributor_lastname': str,
        'contributor_firstname': str,
        'contributor_city': str,
        'contributor_state': str,
        'contributor_zip': str,
        'contributor_employer': str,
        'contributor_occupation': str,
        'contributor_is_self_employed': bool,
        'amount': float
    })

    # Write the result to CSV
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
